title: Full-Stack & Görüntü İşleme Mühendisi (React / Java / Python)
description: Büyüyen ekibimize, ölçeklenebilir uygulamalar geliştirmeye ve gerçek dünya problemlerini görüntü işleme ile çözmeye tutkuyla yaklaşan yeni bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Hem frontend–backend geliştirme süreçlerinde hem de görüntü işleme ve veri odaklı modellerde çalışmaktan keyif alıyorsanız, bu rol tam size göre. SORUMLULUKLAR Yazılım Geliştirme React.js ile web uygulamaları geliştirmek ve sürdürmek (Vue.js deneyimi artı değer). Java (tercihen Spring Boot) ile backend servisleri ve REST API’leri geliştirmek. Temiz, test edilebilir ve iyi dokümante edilmiş kod yazmak. Agile/Scrum ekipleri ile uyum içinde çalışmak. İlişkisel veya NoSQL veritabanları ile çalışmak. Görüntü İşleme Büyük ölçekli görüntü/video verilerini işlemek, analiz etmek ve yönetmek. Yapılandırılmamış veriler üzerinde görüntü işleme teknikleri uygulamak. Nesne tespiti, takip, segmentasyon gibi alanlarda derin öğrenme modelleri geliştirmek, değerlendirmek ve optimize etmek. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, YOLO, OpenCV, NumPy, PIL vb. kütüphaneleri aktif şekilde kullanmak. Görüntü analizi algoritmaları tasarlamak ve bunu üretim ortamlarına entegre etmek. Kurum içinde öngörüsel karar mekanizmalarını otomatikleştiren modeller geliştirmek. Minimum Gereksinimler Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Elektrik/Elektronik Mühendisliği veya ilgili bir alanda Lisans/Yüksek Lisans derecesi (veya eşdeğer tecrübe). Yazılım geliştirme veya görüntü işleme alanında en az 2–4 yıl deneyim (en az 1+ yıl görüntü işleme deneyimi güçlü bir artıdır). Aşağıdaki konularda güçlü bilgi birikimi: React.js veya benzer frontend framework’leri Java & OOP (Spring Boot bilgisi tercih edilir) Python ve CV/ML kütüphaneleri (OpenCV, NumPy, PyTorch/TensorFlow vb.) Nesne tespiti, takip veya segmentasyon modelleri konusunda deneyim. NVIDIA GPU veya bulut tabanlı eğitim ortamlarında çalışabilme. Git ve versiyon kontrol süreçleri konusunda yetkinlik. Tercih Edilen Nitelikler Docker/Kubernetes ve bulut platformları (AWS, Azure, GCP) bilgisi. ML araştırmalarını üretim ortamına aktarabilme becerisi. Veri yapıları ve algoritmalar konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak. UI/UX prensiplerine ilgi. IoT teknolojilerine aşinalık. İmkanlar Agile Ekip: Dinamik, destekleyici ve çevik bir ekiple çalışma fırsatı. Öğrenme & Gelişim: Mentorluk ve sürekli öğrenme kültürü, Udemy & Coursera erişimi, Eğitim ve konferans desteği, Düzenli Product & Tech Talks Yan Haklar: Yemek kartı, Doğum günü izni, Ekipman desteği, Özel sağlık sigortası Çalışma Esnekliği: Projeye bağlı olarak hibrit veya remote çalışma seçenekleri

title: Digital Assets Backend Engineer
description: Design the future architecture of one of Europe's most innovative banking networks while empowering engineers to do their best work. Role Summary We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build the next generation of digital asset, tokenization, and distributed financial infrastructure capabilities within ING. You will design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, integration layers, event-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms that support emerging digital asset and distributed ledger initiatives. While prior blockchain experience is welcome, it is not required. We are primarily looking for strong software engineers who are passionate about building resilient, secure, and high-performing distributed systems and are interested in expanding into the blockchain and digital assets domain. Work Model At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit—it's part of how we work. Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote. We also provide additional flexibility throughout August with remote working opportunities, allowing colleagues to remain productive while staying connected with their teams. As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations and contribute to solutions used across the bank. About the Team You will join an international technology organization where ownership, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engineering excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our teams design and deliver critical technology platforms that support ING's digital transformation journey. We believe scalable architectures, strong engineering practices, automation, and continuous learning are essential for delivering reliable solutions at scale. About You Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution design, or architecture roles Strong stakeholder management experience across business and technology domains Excellent communication and presentation skills Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities Experience working in Agile organizations Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline Fluent English communication skills (C1 level or above) Technical Skills Strong experience in: Java (preferred) Kotlin Spring Boot REST APIs Microservices Architecture Experience with: Event-driven architectures Kafka RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies SQL and NoSQL databases Containerization (Docker) Kubernetes CI/CD pipelines Git-based development workflows Good understanding of: Distributed systems System integration API design Scalability patterns Roles and Responsibilities Backend Engineering & Platform Development Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs. Develop microservice-based applications running on cloud-native platforms. Create robust integration solutions between internal banking systems and emerging digital asset platforms. Build highly available, secure, and resilient services handling financial transactions and business-critical processes. Participate in architecture discussions covering scalability, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability. Distributed Systems & Digital Assets Support the design and implementation of distributed financial platforms. Contribute to digital asset, tokenization, and blockchain-related initiatives. Work on transaction workflows, settlement processes, custody integrations, and digital asset servicing capabilities. Learn and apply distributed ledger technologies where appropriate. Collaborate with blockchain engineers and architects on selected use cases. Engineering Excellence Build automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. Apply clean code principles and software craftsmanship practices. Improve observability, monitoring, logging, and operational resilience. Support production environments and participate in incident resolution activities. Contribute to reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities. Security & Compliance Implement security-by-design principles. Apply secure coding standards and software development best practices. Work closely with security, risk, and compliance teams. Ensure regulatory and internal control requirements are considered throughout solution delivery. Collaboration Work in Agile squads with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, SREs, and Security Specialists. Collaborate with global ING engineering teams. Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities, demos, and innovation initiatives. Equal Opportunity Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. What We Offer at ING Hubs Türkiye At ING Hubs Türkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. We pay attention to even the smallest details to ensure that your experience is rewarding. Be Yourself, Be an ING'er Welcome Leave: Enjoy 14 days of welcome leave, even in your first year Self-driven career opportunities Challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities Flexible hybrid working model Remote working opportunities throughout August Training budget and Udemy partnership Global mobility and international career opportunities Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family Private Pension Plan Meal Card Transportation Allowance MultiSport Membership English Language Development Support Innovation culture powered by PACE methodology Regular communication activities and celebrations About ING With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Kotlin + React)
description: About Metric Maestro We build the measurement layer for security management: a system of record that turns raw security tool data into standardized, auditable KPIs for enterprise customers. Our stack is Spring Boot/Kotlin on the backend and Next.js/React on the frontend. We're small, and you'd be joining the founding engineering team. Your decisions will still be in the codebase years from now. The role Backend-heavy full stack. You'll design services in Kotlin, model the data our KPI engine runs on, and build the interfaces that expose it. You'll own features end to end and have real say in architecture — we're not handing out pre-scoped tickets. Fully remote. No office, no hybrid days. We hire only within Türkiye so the team shares one timezone. Requirements 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience Strong production experience with Kotlin and Spring Boot — REST API design, JPA/Hibernate, PostgreSQL Solid React and TypeScript; comfortable owning frontend work without a designer holding your hand Docker, Linux, Git, CI/CD as everyday tools Python for automation and data processing You already build with AI coding tools daily — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent. Not "I've tried Copilot." We mean it's part of how you work, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. English strong enough to run a technical discussion and write clearly. Most of our written work is in English and you'll talk to enterprise customers. Based in Türkiye with the right to work here What we're looking for Startup engineering is a different job, and not everyone wants it: Requirements change. Sometimes what you shipped last month gets deleted. If that reads as chaos rather than speed, this will be frustrating. You'll work across the stack, including parts you don't know yet. Being the only person who can fix something is normal here. No process to hide behind. Nobody assigns you work — you find it. You'll ship things that aren't perfect, then improve them with real usage data. Nice to have Experience with ETL and data processing pipelines Feel free to include a GitHub or portfolio link in your CV if you have work you'd like us to see. Work model: Full-time, fully remote, Türkiye residency required.

title: Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description: Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre. (Please be aware you need to be located in CET OR LATAM timezone) About Fullinfo Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform. The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources. The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense. The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. Role description As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform. This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable. You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly. Your work includes: • Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda • Building services across the data pipeline • Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services • Improving performance and cost efficiency • Keeping the architecture clean and understandable • Writing code that is easy to read, test and change • Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular • Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts. Requirements You bring: • 5 plus years of backend engineering experience with Node.js/Nest.JS • Real experience with AWS serverless services • Hands on experience with Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS • A strong instinct for clean architecture and maintainability • Comfort working in a small remote team with minimal process • Business level English • You are based within 3 hours of Central European Time or are located in LATAM Conditions • 12 month B2B contract • Up to $80.000 • Fully remote work • Long term project with unlimited extensions The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link. Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Full Stack Web Developer Intern
description: Hakkımızda Biz, köpekler için her gün taze ve sağlıklı yemekler hazırlayan ve onlar için en doğru beslenme planlarını oluşturmaya çalışan bir markayız. Bu süreci yönetirken arka planda teknolojiyi, operasyonu ve veri analitiğini bir arada yürütüyoruz. Her geçen gün büyüyen ve gelişen ekibimizde; öğrenmeye ve gelişime açık, analitik düşünce yapısına sahip ve takım çalışmasına yatkın bir Full Stack Developer Intern arıyoruz. Yeni fikirlerin rahatlıkla paylaşılabildiği ve yeni teknolojileri deneyimleyebileceğin geniş bir gelişim alanına sahip bir çalışma ortamımız var. Web teknolojilerinde kendini geliştirerek fark yaratırken, bir yandan köpek dostlarımızın daha sağlıklı yaşamasına katkı sağlamak istersen başvurunu bekliyoruz. İş Tanımı Şirket bünyesindeki web uygulamalarının ve yazılım projelerinin uçtan uca (Full Stack) tasarımı, geliştirilmesi ve sürdürülebilirliği süreçlerinde aktif rol almak, İş analizinden gelen gereksinimleri derinlemesine analiz ederek ölçeklenebilir, güvenli ve performanslı yazılım çözümleri üretmek, Yazılım mimarisi standartlarına uygun, okunabilir, sürdürülebilir ve temiz kod prensiplerine sadık kalarak geliştirme yapmak, Mevcut süreç ve ürünlerin iyileştirilmesinde proaktif davranarak yenilikçi çözüm önerileri getirmek, Sektör trendlerini ve yeni nesil teknolojileri araştırarak projelerin modernizasyonuna ve ekibin teknik gelişimine katkı sağlamak. Genel Nitelikler Laravel frameworkü ile nesne yönelimli programlama (OOP) ve web uygulamaları geliştirme konusunda deneyimli, İlişkisel veritabanları (SQL) ve anahtar-değer (Key-Value) tabanlı veritabanı yapıları (Redis vb.) konusunda bilgi veya tecrübe sahibi, Temel web teknolojilerine (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) iyi derecede hakim, İş gereksinimlerini doğru analiz ederek etkin çözümler üretebilen; planlı, sistematik ve koordinasyon yeteneği yüksek, Yenilikçi (inovatif) düşünme becerisine sahip, süreç ve ürün geliştirme aşamalarında inisiyatif alarak katma değer yaratabilen, Sürekli öğrenmeye açık, yeni teknolojileri ve sektör trendlerini yakından takip ederek hızla adapte olabilen, Güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip, sorumluluk bilinci yüksek ve takım çalışmasına yatkın. Tercihen Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Bilgisayar Bilimleri veya ilgili bölümlerden lisans derecesine sahip, Git ile versiyon yönetimi süreçlerine ve modern iş akışlarına hakim veya deneyimli, Yazılım mimarilerine, temiz kod (Clean Code) prensiplerine ve en iyi uygulama yöntemlerine (Best Practices) meraklı ve bunları hayata geçirmeye istekli, Modern ön yüz (Frontend) framework'lerinden (React, Vue.js, Svelte, Angular vb.) en az birinde deneyim sahibi, DevOps süreçleri, araçları ve kültürü (CI/CD, Docker vb.) hakkında bilgi sahibi.

title: Software Developer (PHP/MySQL) — Fintech Experience Preferred
description: About Juuli Juuli is a fintech platform built for solopreneurs, freelancers, and B2B businesses, offering financial accounts (IBAN/wallet), card issuing, and payment infrastructure. Our core products help independent professionals and small businesses get paid, manage their finances, and operate internationally with ease. We're a fast-growing, remote-first team building compliant financial infrastructure across multiple jurisdictions. We're looking for a Mid-level Software Developer to join our engineering efforts, working primarily with PHP and MySQL. We work heavily with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor) — you'll be expected to move fast with AI, while maintaining the judgment and discipline to review, test, and take full ownership of what ships to production. What you'll do: Build and maintain features across our PHP/MySQL backend Use AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) as a core part of your daily workflow to move quickly Review, test, and validate AI-generated code before it ships — you own the quality, not the tool Manage version control cleanly through Git (branching, commits, pull requests) Debug and resolve issues across the stack, from database queries to application logic Collaborate with the team on technical decisions and code reviews What we're looking for: Solid experience with PHP and MySQL High proficiency with Claude Code and/or Cursor is essential — comfortable working in an AI-assisted ("vibe coding") workflow while still exercising strong independent judgment and review discipline over what gets shipped Strong Git knowledge (branching, merging, PR workflows) Experience working in fintech is a plus Mid-level experience — you can work independently but this isn't a role requiring deep architectural leadership General familiarity with DigitalOcean Apps and Managed Databases is a plus Strong English (written and spoken) Self-discipline for remote work — available and responsive during working hours (10:00–17:00) Setup: Remote, full-time, working hours 10:00–17:00 We don't run on rigid performance metrics — what matters to us is discipline, ownership, and genuine effort Any relocation or residence/work permit arrangements, if required, are the candidate's own responsibility

Ekibimize katılacak, motivasyonu yüksek ve yetenekli çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. Eğer siz de dijital dünyaya tutkuyla bağlı, sürekli öğrenmeye ve gelişmeye açık bir profesyonelseniz, Gcode ailesine; '‘Full Stack Geliştirici'’ pozisyonuna katılmak için doğru yerdesiniz! Genel Nitelikler: Üniversitelerin ilgili Lisans bölümlerinden mezun (Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği vb.), Full Stack Developer olarak alanında en az 5 yıl deneyimli, Teknik dokümanları anlayacak düzeyde İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip, Yazılım geliştiriciler için PHP programlamada tecrübeli (PHP 8 ile güncel Laravel framework kullanarak projeler geliştirmiş), Nesneye yönelik programlama (OOP, MVC, Design Patterns) konusunda bilgi sahibi, Best practices, SOLID prensipleri, Clean Code ve ölçeklenebilir çözümler konusunda tecrübeli, Entegrasyon projelerinde görev almış, RESTFull API mimarilerine hâkim, Transact SQL ve SQL deneyimli, MS SQL Server, SQL Server Management Studio tecrübesi olan, MicroService mimarisi hakkında bilgi sahibi, CI / CD süreçlerini yürütebilen, Versiyon kontrol sistemleri (TFS, GIT, Bitbucket, Jira vb.) ile çalışmış olan, Scrum, Kanban gibi Agile proje yönetimi metodolojileri ile çalışmada bilgi sahibi, MySQL, PostgreSQL gibi veri tabanları konusunda deneyimli, Web API - Rest mimarisi konusunda deneyimli, HTML5, CSS3, JQuery ve OO JavaScript dillerinde uzman, Typscript, Less/Sass, Responsive tasarımlar (Bootstrap vb.) konusunda bilgi sahibi Cross-browser uyumluluğu konusunda deneyimli. Görev & Sorumluluklar: Projeler dahilindeki masa üstü, mobil ve web tabanlı uygulamaların Full Stack yazılım geliştirme süreçlerinde yer almak, Gelecekte kullanılmak üzere yeniden kullanılabilir kod ve kütüphaneler oluşturma organizasyonunu yürütmek, Mevcut web ürünlerini/projelerini geliştirme ve sürdürme operasyonlarını yönetmek, Geliştirilen kodların testlerinin kontrolünü sağlamak, Uygulamaların dokümantasyonunun (tasarım, geliştirici dokümanı, vb.) oluşturulmasını sağlamak, Müşteri ve kullanıcı geri bildirimlerine istinaden yazılım iyileştirmelerinin yapılmasını düzenlemek, Analitik düşünme becerisiyle problemlere yapısal çözümler getirmek.
